# MOD INFORMATION

This skin replaces base Jax with a custom-made Rictus model. 

It is also an Urpog team collab with HuselPusel, LxVer, and Zetta for Splash Art (Future update).

## CREDITS

* Model, Texture, & VFX: [Bearded Shepherd](https://linktr.ee/BeardedShepherd)
* SFX: [HuselPusel](https://twitter.com/huselpusel)
* SFX Implementation: [LxVer](https://twitter.com/LxVer8)
* Splash Art: [Zetta](https://x.com/ZETTA_AZNEC)

## EXTRA INFOS

* If you would like to support me personally, **Bearded Shepherd**, with the models and textures I create for custom skins made completely from scratch, please consider donating to my [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/DanielMatosArtwork)!
* You can also check out the [artstation post on Rictus's model](https://www.artstation.com/artwork/eRDomJ) for a closer look.

Enjoy!
